positions.title: UAS Aerial Ignition Specialist
positions.requirements_text: Unmanned Aircraft System Pilot (UASP), qualified; Firing Boss, Single Resource (FIRB), qualified or trainee.

extra_fields.required_experience: Satisfactory performance as UASP on ≥X incidents; participation in ≥X ignition operations.
extra_fields.currency: RT-373 (triennial); ≥1 aerial ignition mission per 3 years; maintain UASP currency.

required_training.source_provider: FAA knowledge test (PSI/CATS centers); prep via Pilot Institute / Drone Pilot Ground School
DOI Office of Aviation Services (OAS) / agency
NWCG via agency / Wildland Fire Learning Portal
Drone Amplified; USFS UAS Aerial Ignition Academy (agency)
required_training.approx_cost: Vendor-quoted, often bundled w/ platform; agency academy internal

qualification_stack.Aspirant: Interest in UAS/fire ops; ICS-100; basic fireline & aviation safety awareness.
qualification_stack.Beginner: FAA Part 107; RT-130; agency UAS authority; UASP trainee.
qualification_stack.Journey: UASP qualified; FIRB; S-219; vendor ignition course; RT-373 current.
qualification_stack.Expert: Multi-mission ignition experience; AIML track; instructor/evaluator.

employers_by_sector.Private: Drone Amplified (IGNIS); UAS service & prescribed-burn contractors; utility vegetation programs.
employers_by_sector.Federal: USFS (UAS Aerial Ignition Academy); DOI bureaus via OAS (BLM, NPS, FWS, BIA); interagency UAS program (NIFC).
employers_by_sector.Other public sector: State forestry/fire agencies (e.g., CAL FIRE, state DNRs); tribal fire programs; prescribed-burn associations.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~100–300 and growing (rough estimate; a subset of federal/state UAS pilots cross-trained for ignition).

positions.title: Aerial Ignition Module Lead
positions.requirements_text: UAS Aerial Ignition Specialist (UAIS), qualified; Firing Boss (FIRB), qualified; Prescribed Fire Burn Boss Type 2 (RXB2), qualified or trainee.

extra_fields.required_experience: Lead role on ≥X aerial ignition operations.
extra_fields.currency: Maintain UAIS and FIRB currency; ≥1 lead ignition assignment per 3 years.

qualification_stack.Aspirant: UAS ignition familiarity; ICS leadership awareness.
qualification_stack.Beginner: UAIS trainee; FIRB experience; supervision coursework.
qualification_stack.Journey: UAIS + FIRB qualified; RXB2 trainee; leads a small ignition module.
qualification_stack.Expert: RXB2 qualified; multi-resource ignition lead; mentors UAIS.

employers_by_sector.Private: A small number of vendor/contractor ignition leads.
employers_by_sector.Federal: USFS & DOI prescribed-fire and UAS programs.
employers_by_sector.Other public sector: State/tribal burn bosses adopting UAS ignition.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~25–75 (rough estimate; emerging lead role with few formal holders).

positions.title: Remote Sensing Specialist
positions.requirements_text: Geographic Information System Specialist (GISS), qualified or trainee.

extra_fields.required_experience: Production of geospatial products on ≥X incidents.
extra_fields.currency: ≥1 product-delivery assignment per 3 years; maintain GISS currency.

required_training.approx_cost: Software-driven: Agisoft Metashape Pro ~$3,499 perpetual; Pix4Dmapper ~$3,500/yr; QGIS free

qualification_stack.Aspirant: Interest in geospatial/RS; intro GIS; ICS-100.
qualification_stack.Beginner: GISS trainee; QGIS/ArcGIS basics; NASA ARSET fundamentals.
qualification_stack.Journey: GISS qualified; S-495; photogrammetry/LiDAR proficiency; delivers products.
qualification_stack.Expert: Advanced sensor fusion; GEOL track; mentors GISS/RSEN.

employers_by_sector.Private: Technosylva, Overstory; geospatial/mapping firms; UAS mapping contractors; utilities.
employers_by_sector.Federal: USFS Geospatial Technology & Applications Center (GTAC); DOI; USGS; NASA.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~300–800 in wildfire-focused remote sensing (rough estimate; far larger general RS workforce).

positions.title: Geospatial Operations Lead
positions.requirements_text: Remote Sensing Specialist (RSEN), qualified; GISS, qualified.

extra_fields.currency: ≥1 lead geospatial assignment per 3 years; maintain RSEN currency.

qualification_stack.Beginner: GISS qualified; RSEN trainee; supervision coursework.
qualification_stack.Journey: RSEN + GISS qualified; data-pipeline capability; leads geospatial unit.
qualification_stack.Expert: Multi-source architecture; command advisor; cadre lead/instructor.

employers_by_sector.Federal: USFS GTAC; GISS cadre leads; NIFC.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~100–250 (rough estimate; small lead cohort).

qualification_stack.Beginner: Vendor platform basics; RF fundamentals; supervised installs.
qualification_stack.Journey: Independent install, calibration, and maintenance across platforms.
qualification_stack.Expert: Network design; fault-isolation lead; trains technicians.

employers_by_sector.Private: Pano AI, Dryad, Torch, Gridware; installation/telecom contractors.
employers_by_sector.Other public sector: State programs (e.g., ALERTCalifornia / UC San Diego); utilities (quasi-public).

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~200–600 and growing (rough estimate; camera/sensor deployment & maintenance crews).

qualification_stack.Beginner: Platform operator training; dispatch familiarization; supervised monitoring.
qualification_stack.Expert: Multi-source corroboration lead; shift lead; trains operators.

employers_by_sector.Other public sector: State dispatch/intel centers (e.g., CAL FIRE); ALERTCalifornia operators; emergency comms centers.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~500–1,500 (rough estimate; overlaps dispatch/intel staff who triage detections).

employers_by_sector.Private: Pano AI, OroraTech, Dryad, Torch, Overstory, Gridware; Earth Fire Alliance/FireSat partners; big tech.
employers_by_sector.Other public sector: Universities (e.g., UC San Diego); research institutes.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~100–300 working specifically on wildfire detection ML (rough estimate).

positions.title: Autonomous Systems Operator
positions.requirements_text: UASP or equivalent platform certification; operations background.

extra_fields.currency: Maintain platform currency; ≥1 supervised autonomous operation per 3 years.

qualification_stack.Beginner: FAA Part 107 / platform cert; supervised autonomous ops.
qualification_stack.Expert: Complex multi-asset ops; contingency lead; trains operators.

employers_by_sector.Federal: Emerging (DoD-adjacent programs; USFS pilots in trials).

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~25–100 (rough estimate; nascent, concentrated at a few firms).

qualification_stack.Journey: Independent deploy, integrate, and maintain in field conditions.
qualification_stack.Expert: Reliability-engineering lead; new-platform bring-up; mentors engineers.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~50–150 (rough estimate; small, early-stage field-robotics cohort).

positions.title: Autonomy Software Engineer
positions.requirements_text: Software-engineering background in robotics/UAS or safety-critical systems.

extra_fields.required_experience: ≥X modules delivered to a validated system.
extra_fields.currency: Active development contribution within the prior 12 months.

qualification_stack.Expert: Safety-critical architecture; flight-test lead; sets engineering standards.

employers_by_sector.Private: Rain, Drone Amplified, BurnBot; autonomy/aerospace firms.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~100–300 in fire-relevant autonomy (rough estimate; overlaps broader robotics SWE pool).

positions.title: Computational Fire Modeler
positions.requirements_text: Data-science / computational background; fire-science grounding (FBAN familiarity supports).

extra_fields.currency: Active modeling contribution within the prior 12 months.

qualification_stack.Aspirant: Quantitative foundation; interest in fire science.
qualification_stack.Journey: Independent model build, calibration, validation, and delivery.
qualification_stack.Expert: Ensemble/uncertainty leadership; FBAN collaboration; sets modeling standards.

employers_by_sector.Private: Technosylva, Vibrant Planet; wildfire-analytics & catastrophe-modeling firms (insurers); utilities.
employers_by_sector.Federal: USFS Missoula Fire Sciences Laboratory; USGS; national labs (LANL FIRETEC, LLNL); NOAA.

extra_fields.workforce_estimate: Approx. number performing this work in the USA (any title): ~200–600 (rough estimate; FBAN cadre plus private computational modelers).
